clips.title: The story
paras: At Bloodhoof Village, Ruul Eagletalon watches the settlement’s borders. He keeps an eye on Mulgore’s wildlife, especially the aggressive Windfury harpies pressing into tauren lands.

Ruul Eagletalon tends to Bloodhoof Village’s security as young braves arrive from Camp Narache. Mulgore is a peaceful homeland beside the arid wastes of the Barrens, yet territorial predators and hostile creatures still press against its pastures. Ruul watches for dangers on the nearby plains and directs capable travelers against the savage Windfury harpies, which prey on unwary nomads and game.
